expectedRealization.rationale: Legacy-memory supply changes and contract-price resets can affect one to two reporting cycles; 60d is the base horizon.

changeHypothesis.summary: DDR4/LPDDR4 moved into a structural shortage as capacity migrated to higher-value memory. 兆易创新 was the cleanest A-share quality expression versus peers, but its H1 realized earnings acceleration was only moderate and its valuation/price had already rerated, weakening downside asymmetry.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: TrendForce repeatedly raised legacy-memory pricing and shortage expectations through July-August.
disconfirmingEvidence: Industry evidence shares one specialist origin.
兆易创新 H1 profit growth was only 11.3% and CFO fell.
The stock had already materially outperformed over both 20d and 60d.

causalChain.mechanism: Supplier EOL and high-end capacity allocation reduce legacy supply.
Higher contract prices benefit suppliers with direct memory exposure and better product economics.
causalChain.failureMode: wafer/input costs or weak end-demand offset ASP gains

causalChain.mechanism: The selected name must offer more unreflected revision headroom and downside protection than memory peers.
causalChain.failureMode: price rerates before earnings acceleration arrives

substitutes: newer memory generations and alternative vendors

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The physical shortage was already visible and the stock basket had positive 20/60d relative momentum. 兆易创新's Aug22 valuation was about 64.6x 2025E and 48.3x 2026E.
expectations.thesisExpectation: H2 legacy-memory price increases could drive faster earnings than H1.
expectations.measurableGap: There is plausible H2 revision headroom, but much of the shortage narrative and quality premium was already reflected in price.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus H2 earnings bridge versus memory peers.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2025E/2026E profit RMB1.55/2.07bn and PE 64.6/48.3x on Aug22 reference.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: H2 memory ASP/mix accelerates enough to lift 2025/26 estimates beyond the frozen baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Incremental revisions must more than offset the already-rich multiple and prior 20/60d outperformance.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Memory prices rise but the stock only meets already-embedded H2 acceleration, leading to multiple compression.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q3 contract prices and the next earnings report can expose H2 acceleration within 20-60 trading days.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: External legacy-memory price acceleration is strong; company H1 acceleration is more modest.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: H1 remained profitable and growing, but the main shortage acceleration had not fully reached reported earnings.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: Peers showed weaker profit quality or higher valuation.

baselineLag.rationale: The frozen annual forecast may lag the magnitude of the late-Q3 physical price reset.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Use frozen 20/60d relative-return regime and forward valuation.

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: Legacy-memory price increases accelerated sharply in July-August.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Physical impulse and price breadth are aligned, but valuation and prior appreciation raise risk.

revisionHeadroom.rationale: Late-Q3 legacy-memory price acceleration may exceed the frozen annual earnings baseline.

valuationSlack.rationale: Forward valuation was rich despite being better than Beijing Junzheng.

catalystReachability.rationale: Contract prices and Q3 earnings can reveal the H2 reset within the base horizon.

downsideContainment.rationale: High valuation plus strong prior outperformance creates meaningful multiple-compression risk.
